children: Swarmer signed a Purchase Agreement to acquire 100% of Ratel Robotics, with an estimated $7.2 million cash payment and 1,064,942 shares at closing, plus up to $7.2 million in cash earnouts and up to 4,422,125 additional shares tied to 2026-2028 performance. Closing is targeted for the fourth quarter of 2026, pending stockholder approval for the stock issuance, regulatory clearances and other conditions. In connection with the deal, sellers will be subject to a six-month lock-up on issued shares, and Swarmer will provide registration rights to facilitate future resale when Form S-3 eligibility is available. The transaction is intended to expand Swarmer’s robotics capabilities and align incentives with performance.
